body:
The diff is doc-comment-only. All required verification passed for my set:
- `cargo rustc ... -W missing_docs`: zero domain files remain (only `adapters/mod.rs` and `open_mtr_client.rs`, owned by other agents).
- `RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p open-mtr-core --no-deps`: no diagnostics referencing any domain file (the remaining errors are in `adapters/trait_def.rs`, `client/token.rs`, `error.rs`, and a reqwest link — outside my set).
- `cargo check -p open-mtr-core --lib`: compiles clean.

One correction applied to the parent's brief: `DataMtr` serializes as `dd-MM-yyyy` (not ISO 8601); plain `NaiveDate`/`NaiveDateTime` fields use derived ISO serialization. Docs state the real code behavior.

Documented every public item across all 14 files in `core/src/openmtr/domain/**`: module roots, structs, all fields, enum variants (including `StatusMtr::Outro` round-trip), newtypes, constructors and methods. Covered the requested wire contracts (`TimestampMs` epoch ms, `CpfCnpj` normalization, romaneio-unit `quantidade`, `BTreeMap` deterministic tables, `dias`→`ultimos_dias` Clock determinism). No code, signatures, derives, serde attributes or tests changed; no commits made.
